post.text:
Iranian Air Defense has shot down "something" likely a fighter jet over Tehran 🚀

Notice the smoke on impact [Indicates jet fuel] & the speed of the falling object. https://t.co/P6dy0RdnM2
post.author_description: PSF is an independent think tank run by an international team of researchers, delivering the intelligence you need to make informed decisions on geopolitics.

description.description: A series of four frames from a night video shows a city skyline under a dark sky. A bright, glowing object is seen descending through the clouds and moving toward the city buildings in the background. Each frame tracks the object's downward trajectory over the urban area. A colorful graphic logo in Arabic script is present in the top right corner of every frame.
